description: The autoplay filter is designed for large screen displays and automatically cycles through data items within the slicer to create an automatic playback effect for report charts. This component supports three types of data: text, numerical, and date. Special configuration properties are provided for each type. For numerical data, you can set the minimum and maximum values, as well as the incremental range for each filter cycle. If the incremental range is set to '0', it will filter the values in the data slots sequentially rather than by intervals. Date data can be sliced by year, month, or day. Text data filters based on the values in the data slots. Additionally, you can set the filter playback order (ascending or descending), interval time, and display text style.
